description: Find offers you can call for a task, ranked: describe what you are trying to do in task and get a short list of priced offers (marketplace pricing functions and paid x402 services), each with how to call it, its price per call, where that price sits against what paid x402 services list, and why it is in the list. Places marked ranked are earned on measured results (the Elo Index) and relevance; places marked explore are new offers not yet measured, about a fifth of the list by default. Nobody pays for a place. Narrow with category and max_price (USD per call). When you call an offer, send the feed reference it carries as the x-lp-feed-ref header. Public: needs no credential, limited per address. Until it is switched on it answers not released.

category.description: Only offers in this category (a marketplace vertical such as saas, or an x402 category such as inference).

explore_share.description: Share of places for new, unmeasured offers. Defaults to 0.2.

max_price.description: Most you will pay per call, in USD.

task.description: What you are trying to do, in your own words.

name: discover_offers
